title: Deuteronomy Chapter 22 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Deuteronomy chapter 22 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Deuteronomy Chapter 22 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Deuteronomy Chapter 22.

questions.question: What must you do if you see your brother's ox or sheep go astray?
options: Hide yourself and do nothing
Bring it again unto your brother
Sell it to someone else
Ignore it
questions.correctAnswer: Bring it again unto your brother
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:1 commands that if you see your brother's ox or sheep go astray, you must not hide yourself but bring them again unto your brother.

questions.question: If your brother is not near or you do not know him, what should you do with his lost animal or property?
options: Leave it where it is
Take it to your own house until your brother seeks it
Sell it and keep the money
Give it to the elders of the city
questions.correctAnswer: Take it to your own house until your brother seeks it
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:2 instructs that if your brother is not near or you do not know him, you should bring the lost item to your own house and keep it until your brother seeks after it.

questions.question: Which of the following lost items must you treat the same way as oxen or sheep?
options: His donkey and his raiment
His house and land
His gold and silver
His servants
questions.correctAnswer: His donkey and his raiment
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:3 says to do the same for his ass (donkey) and his raiment (clothing) as you would for his ox or sheep.

questions.question: What are you commanded to do if you see your brother's ass or ox fallen on the way?
options: Ignore it and pass by
Help to lift it up again
Kill the animal
Report it to the city elders
questions.correctAnswer: Help to lift it up again
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:4 commands you to help lift up your brother's ass or ox if it falls down on the way.

questions.question: True or False: According to Deuteronomy 22:5, it is acceptable for a woman to wear men's clothing.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:5 states that a woman shall not wear that which pertains to a man, nor shall a man wear a woman's garment, as these are abominations to the LORD.

questions.question: If you find a bird's nest with eggs and the mother bird sitting on them, what should you do?
options: Take the mother bird and the eggs
Take the eggs only and let the mother bird go
Take the mother bird only and leave the eggs
Destroy the nest
questions.correctAnswer: Take the eggs only and let the mother bird go
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:6-7 instructs not to take the mother bird with the young but to let the mother bird go and take the young to prolong your days.

questions.question: What must you do when you build a new house concerning its roof?
options: Make a battlement for your roof
Paint the roof red
Build the roof with gold
Leave the roof open
questions.correctAnswer: Make a battlement for your roof
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:8 commands that when building a new house, you must make a battlement for your roof to prevent anyone from falling and causing bloodshed.

questions.question: True or False: According to Deuteronomy 22:9, you are allowed to sow your vineyard with different kinds of seeds.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:9 prohibits sowing a vineyard with diverse seeds to avoid defiling the fruit of the vineyard and seed.

questions.question: Which of the following is forbidden according to Deuteronomy 22:10?
options: Plowing with two oxen
Plowing with an ox and an ass together
Plowing with a donkey only
Plowing with a horse
questions.correctAnswer: Plowing with an ox and an ass together
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:10 forbids plowing with an ox and an ass together.

questions.question: What kind of garment is forbidden to wear together according to Deuteronomy 22:11?
options: Wool and linen
Cotton and silk
Leather and wool
Silk and linen
questions.correctAnswer: Wool and linen
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:11 forbids wearing a garment of diverse sorts, specifically wool and linen mixed together.

questions.question: What must you make on the four corners of your garment?
options: Buttons
Fringes
Pockets
Tassels
questions.correctAnswer: Fringes
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:12 commands to make fringes on the four corners of the garment wherewith you cover yourself.

questions.question: True or False: In Deuteronomy 22, if a man falsely accuses his wife of not being a virgin, the elders shall punish him.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:18 states that the elders shall take and chastise the man who falsely accuses his wife of not being a virgin.

questions.question: What is the penalty if a man is found lying with a married woman?
options: They shall both be fined
They shall both be stoned to death
Only the man shall be punished
They shall be exiled
questions.correctAnswer: They shall both be stoned to death
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:22 commands that both the man and the married woman shall die by stoning if found lying together.

questions.question: In Deuteronomy 22, which command comes first?
options: Do not wear a garment of divers sorts
Bring back your brother's lost ox or sheep
Make fringes on your garment
Do not plow with an ox and an ass together
questions.correctAnswer: Bring back your brother's lost ox or sheep
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:1 is the first instruction in the chapter, commanding to bring back your brother's lost ox or sheep.

questions.question: True or False: You may take the mother bird together with her eggs if you find a nest.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:6 clearly commands not to take the mother bird with the young or eggs, but to let the mother go and take only the young.

medium.title: Deuteronomy Chapter 22 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Deuteronomy Chapter 22 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 22:11, what is forbidden to wear?
options: A garment of divers sorts, as of woollen and linen together
Clothes made only of wool
Garments dyed in bright colors
Only linen garments
questions.correctAnswer: A garment of divers sorts, as of woollen and linen together
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:11 explicitly forbids wearing garments made of mixed materials, specifically wool and linen together, emphasizing purity and separation in dress.

questions.question: What does Deuteronomy 22:12 instruct a person to make on their garment?
options: Fringes on the four quarters
A hood for the head
A belt with tassels
A cloak of animal skins
questions.correctAnswer: Fringes on the four quarters
questions.explanation: Verse 12 commands making fringes on the four corners of the garment, a practice to remind the wearer of God's commandments, linking to the call for obedience in verses 11 and 12.

questions.question: What is the consequence described in Deuteronomy 22:19 if a man falsely accuses his wife of not being a virgin?
options: He shall pay a hundred shekels of silver and she shall remain his wife
He shall be stoned to death
He shall divorce her without payment
He shall be exiled from the city
questions.correctAnswer: He shall pay a hundred shekels of silver and she shall remain his wife
questions.explanation: According to verses 18 and 19, if a man falsely accuses his wife, the elders shall chastise him and fine him a hundred shekels, and the woman shall remain his wife, teaching accountability and protection of innocent reputation.

questions.question: What must the father and mother do if a man accuses their daughter of not being a virgin, according to Deuteronomy 22:15?
options: Bring the tokens of virginity to the elders
Send her away from the city
Confront the man privately
Allow the man to divorce her
questions.correctAnswer: Bring the tokens of virginity to the elders
questions.explanation: Verse 15 instructs the parents to present evidence of their daughter's virginity to the city elders, ensuring justice and protection for the woman, which ties to the process described in verses 13-19.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 22:13-14, what behavior does the man exhibit after taking a wife?
options: He hates her and spreads an evil name against her
He cares for her and honors her
He ignores her entirely
He praises her publicly
questions.correctAnswer: He hates her and spreads an evil name against her
questions.explanation: Verses 13 and 14 describe a man who takes a wife but then hates her and falsely accuses her of not being a virgin, illustrating the Biblical warning against slander and dishonesty in marriage.

questions.question: What does Deuteronomy 22:20-21 prescribe if the accusations against a young woman about her virginity are true?
options: She shall be stoned to death at her father's door
She shall be divorced but spared
She shall be banished from the city
She shall marry the man who accused her
questions.correctAnswer: She shall be stoned to death at her father's door
questions.explanation: Verses 20 and 21 state that if the accusation is confirmed, the young woman shall be taken to her father's house door and stoned to death, showing the severe consequences of unchastity and falsehood in Israelite law.

questions.question: How does Deuteronomy 22:22 instruct the community to deal with adultery involving a married woman?
options: Both the man and the woman shall die
Only the man shall be punished
Only the woman shall be punished
They shall be divorced and exiled
questions.correctAnswer: Both the man and the woman shall die
questions.explanation: Verse 22 teaches that both parties caught in adultery shall be put to death, emphasizing the seriousness of marital faithfulness in Israelite society.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 22:23-24, what is the reason the virgin betrothed woman is punished if found lying with a man in the city?
options: Because she did not cry out for help in the city
Because she willingly committed adultery
Because she was unclean before marriage
Because she was not betrothed
questions.correctAnswer: Because she did not cry out for help in the city
questions.explanation: Verse 24 explains that the betrothed virgin is punished because she did not cry out for help, implying consent or failure to resist, which justifies the harsh penalty alongside the man.

questions.question: What is the difference in punishment between a betrothed virgin raped in the field and one found in the city, according to Deuteronomy 22:25-27?
options: The man only dies if the rape occurs in the field; the woman is innocent
Both die regardless of location
Only the woman is punished in the field
Both are forgiven if in the field
questions.correctAnswer: The man only dies if the rape occurs in the field; the woman is innocent
questions.explanation: Verses 25-27 differentiate the case of rape in the field, where the man alone is punished and the woman is declared innocent due to her cries for help, contrasting with the city case where both are punished.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 22:28-29, what must a man do if he lies with a virgin who is not betrothed?
options: Pay fifty shekels to her father and marry her
Leave her and pay no penalty
Marry her without paying anything
Be stoned for dishonoring her
questions.correctAnswer: Pay fifty shekels to her father and marry her
questions.explanation: Verses 28 and 29 require the man to pay the virgin's father fifty shekels and take her as his wife, teaching responsibility and restoration after dishonor.

questions.question: What does Deuteronomy 22:30 prohibit regarding marriage relationships?
options: A man shall not marry his father's wife
A man shall not marry his sister
A man shall not marry a widow
A man shall not marry outside his tribe
questions.correctAnswer: A man shall not marry his father's wife
questions.explanation: Verse 30 prohibits a man from marrying his father's wife, emphasizing respect for family boundaries and honoring parental relationships.

questions.question: What does Deuteronomy 22:8 teach about building a new house?
options: To build a battlement on the roof to prevent anyone from falling
To build a cellar for food storage
To install a water well nearby
To build a fence around the property
questions.correctAnswer: To build a battlement on the roof to prevent anyone from falling
questions.explanation: Verse 8 commands building a parapet or battlement on the roof to keep people safe, showing God’s concern for community safety and responsibility.

questions.question: What does Deuteronomy 22:9 forbid doing in a vineyard?
options: Sowing diverse seeds together
Watering with unclean water
Planting trees nearby
Harvesting early
questions.correctAnswer: Sowing diverse seeds together
questions.explanation: Verse 9 forbids sowing a vineyard with multiple seed types to avoid defiling the produce, reinforcing purity and order in agriculture.

questions.question: How does Deuteronomy 22:10 relate to the principle of not mixing?
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Verse 10 prohibits plowing with an ox and an ass together, consistent with the broader theme of separation and purity seen in verses 9-11, emphasizing obedience and distinction in daily life.

questions.question: True or False: Deuteronomy 22:14 allows a man to publicly accuse his wife of not being a virgin without evidence.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Verse 14 describes such accusations but the following verses (15-19) require evidence and a judicial process, showing that false accusations are punishable and not allowed.

hard.title: Deuteronomy Chapter 22 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Deuteronomy Chapter 22.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 22, what is the prescribed punishment if a man is found lying with a married woman?
options: Only the man shall die
They shall both be stoned to death
Only the woman shall be put away
They shall both be fined
questions.correctAnswer: They shall both be stoned to death
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:22 states that if a man lies with a married woman, both the man and the woman shall die, to put away evil from Israel.

questions.question: What is the difference in judgment between a betrothed virgin found in the city with a man and one found in the field, according to Deuteronomy 22?
options: Both shall be stoned regardless of location
The man only dies if it was in the field; both die if in the city
The woman dies if in the field; the man dies if in the city
Both are forgiven if found in the field
questions.correctAnswer: The man only dies if it was in the field; both die if in the city
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:24-26 explains that if a betrothed virgin is found in the city and lies with a man, both are put to death, but if found in the field and forced, only the man dies.

questions.question: What must a man do if he lies with a virgin who is not betrothed, according to Deuteronomy 22?
options: He must pay fifty shekels of silver to her father and marry her
He must flee to another city
He must be stoned with her
He must offer a sacrifice at the temple
questions.correctAnswer: He must pay fifty shekels of silver to her father and marry her
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:28-29 states that the man who lies with a virgin not betrothed must give fifty shekels to her father and marry her, and may not put her away all his days.

questions.question: What is forbidden concerning a man’s relationship with his father’s wife in Deuteronomy 22?
options: He shall not marry her
He shall not discover his father's skirt
He shall not inherit her property
Both A and B
questions.correctAnswer: Both A and B
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:30 forbids a man from taking his father's wife or discovering his father's skirt, indicating both marriage and sexual relations are prohibited.

questions.question: What literary device is prominently used in Deuteronomy 22:21-24 regarding the punishment of sexual offenses?
options: Chiasmus
Parallelism
Typology
Alliteration
questions.correctAnswer: Parallelism
questions.explanation: The passage uses parallelism by setting similar cases side by side (betrothed virgin in city vs. married woman), highlighting consistent consequences to put away evil (Deuteronomy 22:21-24).

questions.question: What is the significance of the Hebrew term translated as 'tokens of virginity' in Deuteronomy 22:15-17?
options: Physical proof of chastity
A legal document of marriage
A dowry agreement
A ceremonial garment
questions.correctAnswer: Physical proof of chastity
questions.explanation: The Hebrew term refers to physical evidence (tokens) of virginity that a bride’s parents present to the elders to confirm her chastity (Deuteronomy 22:15-17).

questions.question: In Deuteronomy 22, what is the reason given for allowing the mother bird to go free when taking young from a nest?
options: To prevent the dam from attacking
To prolong your days and that it may be well with you
Because it is unlawful to kill a mother bird
To honor the sanctity of life
questions.correctAnswer: To prolong your days and that it may be well with you
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:6-7 commands letting the mother bird go so that it may be well with you and prolong your days, showing a principle of mercy and respect for life.

questions.question: Which other Old Testament passage echoes the theme of protecting a betrothed virgin’s innocence as found in Deuteronomy 22:23-24?
options: Leviticus 20:14
Exodus 22:16-17
Numbers 5:11-31
Judges 19:22-30
questions.correctAnswer: Exodus 22:16-17
questions.explanation: Exodus 22:16-17 similarly addresses the issue of a man lying with a virgin and the consequences, echoing the protection of a betrothed virgin's innocence found in Deuteronomy 22:23-24.

questions.question: Deuteronomy 22:5 forbids cross-dressing. What is the stated reason for this prohibition?
options: It is an abomination to the LORD thy God
It confuses social order
It dishonors the family name
It leads to idolatry
questions.correctAnswer: It is an abomination to the LORD thy God
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:5 explicitly states that wearing garments of the opposite sex is an abomination to the LORD thy God.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage reflects the principle of caring for others' lost property as commanded in Deuteronomy 22:1-3?
options: Luke 10:25-37 (Parable of the Good Samaritan)
Matthew 5:44 (Love your enemies)
Acts 2:44 (Sharing possessions)
John 13:34 (New commandment)
questions.correctAnswer: Luke 10:25-37 (Parable of the Good Samaritan)
questions.explanation: Luke 10:25-37 teaches loving and helping one’s neighbor, similar to the command to return lost property and assist others in Deuteronomy 22:1-3.

questions.question: What is the theological purpose behind the harsh punishments for sexual immorality found in Deuteronomy 22:21-24?
options: To maintain Israel's holiness and remove evil from among them
To impose social class distinctions
To increase population rapidly
To punish women more severely than men
questions.correctAnswer: To maintain Israel's holiness and remove evil from among them
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:21-24 repeatedly states the purpose of putting away evil from Israel, reflecting the covenantal emphasis on holiness.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 22:8, what safety feature must be included when building a new house?
options: A battlement for the roof
A moat around the house
A door with a strong lock
A fireproof ceiling
questions.correctAnswer: A battlement for the roof
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:8 commands that when building a new house, a battlement must be made on the roof to prevent someone from falling and blood being brought upon the house.

questions.question: Which verse forbids sowing a vineyard with diverse seeds, and what is the reason given?
options: Deuteronomy 22:9; to prevent defiling the fruit
Deuteronomy 22:10; to avoid mixing animals
Deuteronomy 22:11; to keep garments pure
Deuteronomy 22:12; to maintain fringes on garments
questions.correctAnswer: Deuteronomy 22:9; to prevent defiling the fruit
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:9 forbids sowing diverse seeds in a vineyard lest the fruit be defiled, highlighting purity laws.

questions.question: True or False: According to Deuteronomy 22:4, if you see your brother’s ox fallen on the road, you are allowed to ignore it if you are busy.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:4 commands that one must not hide but help lift up their brother’s fallen ox or ass on the road.

questions.question: True or False: Deuteronomy 22:11 forbids wearing a mixed fabric garment of wool and linen together.
options: True
False
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:11 explicitly forbids wearing garments made of mixed wool and linen, reflecting purity in clothing.

theological.title: Deuteronomy Chapter 22 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Deuteronomy Chapter 22 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What primary ethical principle is taught by the command to return a brother’s lost ox or sheep, as stated in Deuteronomy 22:1?
options: The principle of loving one’s neighbor through active responsibility
The principle of strict ownership and property rights
The principle of self-preservation over community needs
The principle of ritual purity through separation
questions.correctAnswer: The principle of loving one’s neighbor through active responsibility
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:1 commands not to ignore a brother’s lost ox or sheep but to return them, teaching the ethical responsibility to actively care for one’s neighbor, reflecting God’s call to love and mutual care.

questions.question: According to Deuteronomy 22:5, what theological concern underlies the prohibition against a woman wearing a man’s garment and vice versa?
options: The maintenance of created order and distinction in gender roles
The prohibition of idolatrous symbols in clothing
The avoidance of economic inequality
The promotion of modesty in public worship
questions.correctAnswer: The maintenance of created order and distinction in gender roles
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:5 labels cross-dressing as an abomination to God, indicating a concern for upholding the divinely instituted distinctions in gender reflecting the created order, which is foundational for social and covenantal holiness.

questions.question: What divine attribute is demonstrated by the command in Deuteronomy 22:6-7 to spare the mother bird when taking young or eggs?
options: God’s mercy and care for creation
God’s justice in punishing the wicked
God’s holiness in ritual separation
God’s omnipotence in sustaining life
questions.correctAnswer: God’s mercy and care for creation
questions.explanation: The directive to let the mother bird go while taking the young (Deuteronomy 22:6-7) reveals God’s merciful nature and His care for the living creation, teaching stewardship and compassion.

questions.question: How does the command in Deuteronomy 22:8 about building a battlement on roofs reflect God's concern for human life?
options: It shows God’s attribute of providential protection over His people
It emphasizes ritual cleanliness in housing
It focuses on economic stewardship of property
It commands architectural aesthetics pleasing to God
questions.correctAnswer: It shows God’s attribute of providential protection over His people
questions.explanation: By requiring a protective battlement (Deuteronomy 22:8), God reveals His providential care and concern for preserving human life, emphasizing that holiness includes practical protection of others.

questions.question: What doctrinal principle is taught by the prohibition in Deuteronomy 22:10 against plowing with an ox and an ass together?
options: The principle of holiness through separation of differing kinds
The principle of economic efficiency in agriculture
The principle of animal welfare in labor
The principle of covenantal loyalty to God
questions.correctAnswer: The principle of holiness through separation of differing kinds
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:10 forbids mixing different kinds of animals in labor, illustrating the broader biblical theme that God’s people are called to holiness by maintaining proper distinctions and separations.

questions.question: What combined theological teaching emerges from Deuteronomy 22:9 and 22:11 about mixing seeds and fabrics?
options: God calls His people to live distinct, holy lives by avoiding mixtures that blur created distinctions
God prohibits all forms of agriculture and textile production
God requires all clothing and crops to be identical in type
God focuses only on external appearances for holiness
questions.correctAnswer: God calls His people to live distinct, holy lives by avoiding mixtures that blur created distinctions
questions.explanation: Verses 9 and 11 prohibit mixing seeds and fabrics, teaching that God’s holiness demands His people maintain clear distinctions in their lives, symbolizing purity and separation from worldly corruption.

questions.question: What does the command to make fringes on the corners of garments in Deuteronomy 22:12 symbolize about the believer’s life?
options: A continual reminder of God’s commandments and covenant holiness
An instruction for social status display
A ritual to ward off evil spirits
A symbol of agricultural blessing
questions.correctAnswer: A continual reminder of God’s commandments and covenant holiness
questions.explanation: The fringes commanded in Deuteronomy 22:12 serve as visible signs to remind God’s people to obey His law and live holy lives, reflecting covenant identity and devotion.

questions.question: What does the legal procedure described in Deuteronomy 22:13-19 teach about the protection of a woman’s reputation and justice in Israelite society?
options: It upholds the doctrine of justice by requiring evidence before shame is imposed
It allows men to accuse women without proof
It mandates immediate punishment without trial
It prioritizes family honor over individual rights
questions.correctAnswer: It upholds the doctrine of justice by requiring evidence before shame is imposed
questions.explanation: The detailed process in Deuteronomy 22:13-19 requiring tokens of virginity demonstrates God’s justice, protecting women’s reputations by demanding proof before accusations can damage their honor.

questions.question: How does Deuteronomy 22:20-21 reflect the seriousness with which Israel treated sexual purity, and what broader doctrinal truth does this reveal?
options: Sin, especially sexual sin, corrupts the covenant community and must be removed
All sins are treated equally with no differentiation
Sexual purity was a minor issue in Israelite law
Punishment was primarily symbolic without real consequence
questions.correctAnswer: Sin, especially sexual sin, corrupts the covenant community and must be removed
questions.explanation: The death penalty for proven sexual immorality in Deuteronomy 22:20-21 shows the gravity of sin’s defilement on God’s holy people, underscoring the doctrine of sanctification by removing evil.

questions.question: What theological insight about covenant faithfulness is taught by the death penalty for adultery in Deuteronomy 22:22?
options: God’s covenant demands exclusive loyalty, and violation breaks the community’s holiness
Adultery is a minor offense with little consequence
The law permits forgiveness without penalty for adultery
Covenant faithfulness is optional in Israel’s religion
questions.correctAnswer: God’s covenant demands exclusive loyalty, and violation breaks the community’s holiness
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:22’s punishment for adultery reflects God’s demand for exclusive covenant loyalty, illustrating that sin against marriage is sin against God’s holy community.

questions.question: How do Deuteronomy 22:23-27 differentiate between consensual and non-consensual sexual relations in the case of a betrothed virgin, and what doctrine does this illustrate?
options: The principle of justice distinguishing between sin and victimhood
The principle that all sexual acts outside marriage are equally punishable
The doctrine that betrothal is not legally binding
The idea that women are always responsible for sexual sin
questions.correctAnswer: The principle of justice distinguishing between sin and victimhood
questions.explanation: Verses 23-27 differentiate punishment based on consent, showing God’s justice that punishes the guilty while protecting innocent victims, highlighting the doctrine of righteousness and fairness.

questions.question: What combined doctrinal teaching about marriage and restitution is found in Deuteronomy 22:28-29?
options: Marriage is a covenant that includes responsibility and restitution for wrongs done
Marriage is purely a social contract without divine significance
Restitution is unnecessary if the woman is not betrothed
The man may divorce freely after marriage
questions.correctAnswer: Marriage is a covenant that includes responsibility and restitution for wrongs done
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:28-29 teaches that if a man lies with an unbetrothed virgin, he must pay her father and marry her, showing marriage as a binding covenant requiring accountability and protection of the vulnerable.

questions.question: What attribute of God is revealed in the prohibition of a man marrying his father’s wife in Deuteronomy 22:30?
options: God’s holiness and regard for family order
God’s leniency in family relationships
God’s indifference to marriage regulations
God’s emphasis on economic alliances
questions.correctAnswer: God’s holiness and regard for family order
questions.explanation: The prohibition in Deuteronomy 22:30 reveals God’s holiness which demands respect for sacred family boundaries, maintaining order and purity within the covenant community.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that the harsh penalties for sexual offenses in Deuteronomy 22 are evidence of a cruel and unjust God. What does Deuteronomy 22:20-27 actually teach about God's justice and mercy?
options: God’s justice demands holiness and removal of evil, but His mercy protects the innocent victim
God arbitrarily punishes without cause
God shows no concern for victims or fairness
God’s laws are meant only for public spectacle
questions.correctAnswer: God’s justice demands holiness and removal of evil, but His mercy protects the innocent victim
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 22:20-27 demonstrates that while God’s justice requires punishment for covenant-breaking sins, His mercy ensures protection and innocence for victims, revealing a balance of holiness and compassion.

questions.question: What does the combined instruction of Deuteronomy 22:1-4 about caring for lost animals and fallen beasts reveal about the nature of human responsibility and God’s character?
options: God calls humans to active stewardship, reflecting His compassionate and just nature
God is indifferent to the welfare of animals
Human responsibility is limited to ritual acts
God permits neglect of neighbor’s property
questions.correctAnswer: God calls humans to active stewardship, reflecting His compassionate and just nature
questions.explanation: Verses 1-4 teach that God expects His people to care for others’ property and to help in distress, reflecting His character of justice and compassion and calling humans to mirror these attributes in community life.
